statement: Parchment radiocarbon interval alone establishes the date the visible Voynich text was written.
scope: Logical sufficiency of a support-material measurement; not a test of the actual inscription date
basis: Carbon dating measures the age of sampled parchment material, not the application of ink
test: Attempt inference from radiocarbon support to ink date without an independently dated writing event
result: The inference is invalid because storage and later inscription remain possible
caveat: This does not show the inscription was late.

statement: A digital canvas index may universally stand in for historical MS408 foliated-leaf identity without a mapping or exceptional cases.
scope: Universal identity assumption; NOT any particular Yale image-to-folio mapping or canvas count
basis: SRC-0006 directly records unnumbered leaves and inconsistently foliated foldouts
test: Search primary catalog for missing/unnumbered/ambiguously folded leaf numbering
result: Counterexamples documented; 1:1 unqualified index equivalence not warranted
caveat: A verified explicit canvas-to-physical-surface mapping may still be constructed; manifest not available

statement: Every canvas in the submitted MS408 manifest has a unique simple single-folio-side label enabling direct 1:1 folio-number indexing
scope: User-supplied 403041-byte manifest snapshot only; Yale server provenance not authenticated
basis: Label classification and duplicates in the supplied IIIF JSON
test: Classify all 213 labels; seek compound, descriptive and repeated labels
result: 21 compound/part labels, 9 nonfolio labels and 3 repeated partial label strings
caveat: Explicit concordance still possible; direct site access blocked

statement: Celler Presse/Franke's literal EVA pchor and 2-/3-fold qokedy groups can be located on folio f2v in an independently published transcription witness
scope: Exact separated EVA token strings within VIB's published Currier C f2v.P.1–P.8 witness, not all witnesses or image glyphs
basis: Celler Presse 2026-09-27 literal f2v claims compared with Stolfi/Currier C f2v page presentation
test: Read visible eight Currier C transcription lines; check exact words and consecutive repetitions, preserving compound graphemes
result: cheopchor present but no standalone pchor, no qokedy; therefore the stated exact literal matches are absent in this witness
caveat: Other transcription variants may differ; missing full original-image inspection; a substring pchor in cheopchor is not the same exact EVA word. Does not refute general code or medical content EXP-0005: author publicly explains tokens may be parser-generated outputs; raw absence alone cannot falsify parser output.

statement: A mismatch between literal raw EVA tokens and published derived Eschede system tokens alone falsifies the parser's possible output
scope: Layer confusion only, not source correctness or medical meaning
basis: Franke October 4 addendum and worked f1r example show shol → qokedy via P-12
test: Compare claimed data layer against explicitly published parsing pipeline; seek deterministic transform producing previously absent output tokens
result: Raw token absence does not preclude parser-generated qokedy; standalone raw equivalence is the wrong test
caveat: No independent reproduction of entire f2v parse; published rule overlap shol P-12/P-17 unresolved

statement: The published G1.7 priority ORY>EDY>OL>OTHER alone resolves the archived P-12 versus P-17 functional parser collision on shol
scope: Formal applicability of later G1.7 suffix-class priority to archived P-rule output, not f2v manuscript interpretation

test: Compare priority's output type K(w) with competing P-rule functional outputs for same raw shol
result: G1.7 classifies shol as OL; it does not select between qokedy and catalysis status under older P rule table
caveat: No claim that a separate frozen parser implementation cannot resolve overlap
